name: Handmade Paper of the World
subtitle: Washi, Hanji, Ebru & more
shortDescription: 6 handmade paper and papermaking traditions to play: Ebru marbling, Washi paper, Hanji paper and Lokta paper.
longDescription:
Handmade Paper of the World: 6 handmade paper and papermaking traditions from 6 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Ebru marbling, Washi paper, Hanji paper, Lokta paper, Dutch papierscheppen and Antaimoro flower paper.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can dip the mould, form and couch sheets, press, brush and pound them, and marble paper, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
